speech.heard: In Japan, 30% of people are 65 or older, Zambia has only 2%. Japan is the world's highest, counting all residents regardless of legal status or citizenship. Japan has two times China, China stands at 15%. USA has 18%, Australia and Russia share that figure. Across Europe, Italy has 25%, Germany, Greece and Finland all have 24%. UK has 20%, Nigeria has 3%. At the lowest end, Qatar has 2%, the world's lowest. Where does your country land?
